tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Accent. Toggle knob when on, focus rings, link and button hover. As text it is 3.68:1 on color-surface, so never use it for small resting text.

tokens.name: color-primary-light
tokens.usage: Toggle track when on.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the navbar, buttons, selects.

tokens.name: color-surface-secondary
tokens.usage: The page ground behind cards, and the legend strip inside a card.

tokens.name: color-surface-tertiary
tokens.usage: Toggle track when off or disabled.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Card, control, navbar and footer borders. Decorative, 1.26:1 on color-surface.

tokens.name: color-border-light
tokens.usage: The divider under a pane header.

tokens.name: color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Headlines, body and control text on color-surface and color-surface-secondary. 16.8:1.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Descriptions, pane labels, notes, footer text on color-surface (5.07:1) and color-surface-secondary (4.86:1).

tokens.name: color-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Separators and placeholder text only. 2.57:1 on color-surface, below the 4.5:1 floor, kept exact from the source. Never use it for text that must be read.

tokens.name: color-text-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on color-text-primary fills, such as the main button. 16.8:1.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Text for add, save and active status, on color-surface (5.02:1) and on color-success-light (4.57:1).

tokens.name: color-success-light
tokens.usage: Fill of a soft green button or an active status.

tokens.name: color-success-light-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a soft green button.

tokens.name: color-success-border
tokens.usage: Border of a soft green button.

tokens.name: color-success-border-hover
tokens.usage: Hover border of a soft green button.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Text for destructive actions such as remove and restore defaults, on color-surface (6.47:1) and on color-danger-light (5.30:1).

tokens.name: color-danger-light
tokens.usage: Fill of a soft red button.

tokens.name: color-danger-light-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a soft red button. Same value as color-danger-border, as in the source.

tokens.name: color-danger-border
tokens.usage: Border of a soft red button.

tokens.name: color-danger-border-hover
tokens.usage: Hover border of a soft red button.

tokens.name: color-info
tokens.usage: Text of a neutral notification, on color-info-light (5.17:1).

tokens.name: color-info-light
tokens.usage: Fill of a neutral notification.

tokens.name: color-info-border
tokens.usage: Border of a neutral notification.

tokens.name: color-diff-add
tokens.usage: Highlight behind an added space in the diff.

tokens.name: color-diff-del
tokens.usage: Mark where a removed space was, and the Removed swatch in the legend.

tokens.name: color-diff-row-add
tokens.usage: Row tint for a line that only gained spaces.

tokens.name: color-diff-row-del
tokens.usage: Row tint for a line that only lost spaces.

tokens.name: color-diff-row-mix
tokens.usage: Row tint for a line that both gained and lost spaces.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", "Noto Sans", sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The page headline. One per page.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: The description under the headline, in color-text-secondary.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Notes and the footer, in color-text-secondary.

styles.name: pane
styles.usage: Text in the panes and diff rows. The tall line height keeps mixed Chinese and Latin lines even.
styles.sample: 當你凝視著 bug，bug 也凝視著你

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The site name beside the logo.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Toggle labels, buttons and selects. Controls are never smaller than this.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: URLs, code and patterns the reader must read character by character.

tokens.name: spacing-1
tokens.usage: Wrapped toolbar rows on phones.

tokens.name: spacing-2
tokens.usage: Logo to name, headline to description, toggle to its label, legend swatch to label.

tokens.name: spacing-3
tokens.usage: Button and select padding. Toolbar padding.

tokens.name: spacing-4
tokens.usage: Card and pane padding. Page gutter under 640px.

tokens.name: spacing-5
tokens.usage: Footer padding under 640px.

tokens.name: spacing-6
tokens.usage: Between nav links, between toolbar controls.

tokens.name: spacing-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter, gaps between page sections.

tokens.name: spacing-10
tokens.usage: Below the tool.

tokens.name: spacing-12
tokens.usage: Above the headline.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Toggle track and knob.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The toggle knob.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Overlays that float above the page, such as a notification. Never on a card.

tokens.usage: Section titles. 22px.

tokens.usage: The headline under 640px. 24px.
